name: lvalue-test-e2785cbb54/frozen-value-update-p.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString, toBalString.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions: value:cloneWithType; value:fromJsonWithType; value:toString and value:toBalString.
reason: The asserted panic on record-field mutation depends on first producing a frozen record with b.cloneReadOnly(). That lang.value function is absent from both the supported library and method-syntax lists, so the whole case requires an unsupported feature.
unsupported_constructs: lang.value cloneReadOnly invoked using method syntax
test_design_notes: The @panic assertion tests mutation of the frozen clone; cloneReadOnly is essential to that behavior.
